results.content:
With the midterm elections just weeks away, President Donald Trump’s approval rating is underwater in a super-majority of states, according to new polling.

In a new state-by-state tracker from Civiqs, an online polling firm, more registered voters disapproved than approved of Trump’s job performance in 39 states. [...] Trump has fared even worse on individual issues. An AP-NORC poll released this month found that just 17 percent of U.S. adults approve of his handling of the cost of living, while 26 percent approve of his handling of the economy.

The same poll found that 28 percent approve of his handling of the war with Iran, while 69 percent said the war has not been worth fighting. [...]
